text.title: Family Day · Come and join us!
paragraphs: Who is **faster** — you or your father? Come to Family Day and find out!
THE RACE · 10 a.m. Children and parents run together. Last year Mr Usmonov was **faster** than all the children! Can anybody beat him this year?

THE QUIZ · 11 a.m. Twenty questions about our city. The **twins** Olim and Alim won last year. Olim says he is **smarter** than his brother. Alim says, “No! I am **smarter** than you!” Their mother says they are both **funnier** than their father!

THE TALL TABLE · 12 p.m. We measure everybody. Is your brother **taller** than your mother? Come and see! Last year the tallest person was Rustam from Class 7! Everybody is **different** and everybody is welcome. Bring your family — and bring your smile!
